summary: A calculated formula that reads an Engine-generated dataset at another period now rebuilds it at the formula's own period instead of failing to refresh.
details: Saving a quarterly vector such as an expected loss ratio failed its dependent 'Expected Net Loss % * Earned Premium' with 'operands could not be broadcast together with shapes (40,1) (10,1)', because the Earned Premium was read from its annual file.
The refresh now asks the Engine for the generated dataset at the formula's period, the same way a method reads a generated precedent.
